description: Key Freight Route Secondary Roads is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department of Infrastructure, Transport, Regional Development, Communications, Sport and the Arts. A detailed picture of the secondary road routes connecting Australia's nationally significant places for freight, including ports, airports and intermodal terminals. Coverage: Department of Infrastructure, Transport, Regional Development, Communications, Sport and the Arts. The portal files it under the publisher Department of Infrastructure, Transport, Regional Development, Communications, Sport and the Arts. It offers 2 resource(s) in QGIS, ZIP. The portal shows 2024-11-28 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
